title: This Volcano Blows Smoke Rings Hundreds of Feet Wide

scenes.text: This volcano blows smoke rings hundreds of feet wide.
It's Mount Etna in Italy, and scientists say it makes more of them than any volcano on Earth.
Gas builds up inside the vent, then bursts out as hot vapor at nearly supersonic speed.
The vapor drags against the vent's walls and rolls up into a spinning ring.
In cold air, the ring cools, turns to cloud, and becomes visible.

description:
Mount Etna in Italy blows giant smoke rings, some hundreds of feet across.
It produces more of these vortex rings than any other volcano on Earth.
Would you want to watch it live?
first_comment: Bonus: strong winds stop the rings from forming, so you need calm air. Have you ever seen a volcano erupt?
